violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE PREPARED SAUCES AND VEGETABLES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC REORGANIZE FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: REFRIGERATION UNITS, MICROWAVE, COUNTERS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures: WASHING HANDS WITHOUT APPLY HAND SOAP.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AGAIN USING HAND SOAP. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: RAW MARINATED WINGS AT 44F IN MIGALI 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED FOODS TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: REFRIGERATION UNITS, COUNTERS, UNDER COUNTER AND COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: GRILLED CHICKEN PREPARED 2 DAYS BEFORE WITHOUT DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF WATER, OILS, ETC NEAR GRILL LINE WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY LABLES DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC DURING INSPECTION.

EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION.
